description: Starcoin - A Move smart contract blockchain network that scales by layering
readme_summary: Starcoin - a smart contract blockchain network that scales by layering net proxima using move with table extension feature. If you want to use it, you should compile dev branch. The starcoin project comes with several wrappers/executables, `release` indicates whether the binary is included in the release archive. For prerequisites and detailed build instructions please read Build from source document. `curl --proto '=https' -O --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starcoinorg/starcoin/master/scripts/install_starcoin_mpm.sh | sh install_starcoin_mpm.sh v1.11.12 ` More detailed dev instructions please read Run starcoin dev network document. >note: Account-related commands cannot be used when connecting remotely
